note: RFC 9687 Section 4.3 Event 29 requires a local error message indicating Send Hold Timer Expired. Re-read both tagged functions and the slog capture fixture: SendHoldExpiryRunsTheEvent29ActionList advances exactly SendHoldTime, now requires exact ErrSendHoldTimerExpired, and asserts the actual captured logger contains 'send hold timer expired'; NoSendHoldExpiryLeavesTheSessionIntact advances one nanosecond less and asserts that text absent while retaining Established state and resources. The fake-clock advance crosses no Hold/Keepalive/ConnectRetry deadline. sendHoldTimerExpired produces the named warning-level log; RFC text requires the error indication, not a specific logging API severity level or numeric rendering. The exact-sentinel addition excludes an unrelated Run failure and retains the log assertion. No native red/green was observed by this audit.
